tips.text: Replay and abort after grabbing a missed Genestamp or Ostron; challenge progress carries over, except the password cache, which needs all four glyphs in one run.
Run once for speed on the 15-minute challenge, then do a second slower run for the collectibles.
Start the Veilbreaker chain early so the weekly clock is already running when you want the gun.
Skip the most annoying challenge in a bad week; you only need 60 Stock of the 105.
Skim along the floor with the jetpack glide, melee slams and shoulder-charge rolls to beat the timer.
Do Prison Break's collectibles before the crash; after the Wolf dies your brothers despawn and cannot clear the rubble over the passwords.
Veilbreak Hellions mid-flight so they keep their homing Grakata; they clear the kill challenges for you.
For 5 kills in 5 seconds, use grenades, the Plasma Torch in Sneaky Sabotage, the Kuva Ayanga or Kuaka swarm in Junk Run, or the Grattler in Prison Break.
Expect about two hours of play over four weeks; the missions feel stale by the second or third repeat.
